what_happened.line: The Personnel Committee voted unanimously to accept the HR director's recommended grade and step for the new assistant to the sewer business manager.
The committee discussed warrant article language to change vacation and sick accrual from hours to days; the wording was taken away for review before it is finalized.
The HR director said changing the accrual unit would not affect the budgeting process; how new hires accrue time stays with a separate project.
Most of the meeting re-rated library and Council on Aging positions, lowering two confidentiality ratings and the grades that follow from them.
Further rating changes will be made in a dated copy of the spreadsheet with changed cells highlighted, so they can be compared with the earlier version.

why_it_matters: The vacation and sick time wording is headed for a warrant article, so residents may be asked to vote on it at town meeting.
The re-rating work sets the pay grades of library and Council on Aging jobs, which feed into the town's personnel costs in future budgets.
watch_next: The committee's next meeting on the 28th, where the notice should state the location.
The revised warrant article language on vacation and sick time, once it returns from review.
